glaze_ui.blocker: Manual cross-platform Glaze UI 1.4 acceptance remains required before Stable qualification.

wardveil_security.blocker: Notify has implemented authentication, CSRF, delivery isolation, minimized notification handling, and production-readiness controls, but the explicit Wardveil application contract and target acceptance are not yet complete.

privacy_shield.blocker: Per-user delivery isolation and privacy-safe notification behavior are implemented, but the explicit Privacy Shield application contract and acceptance evidence remain required.

everkeep.blocker: Backup, restore, migration, and rollback procedures exist, but explicit Everkeep application-contract acceptance and target-native recovery evidence remain outstanding.

production_blockers: explicit Wardveil Security application contract and target acceptance
explicit Privacy Shield application contract and acceptance
explicit Everkeep application contract and target recovery acceptance
approved production Android signing and installation validation
representative producer migration and end-to-end delivery validation
